native_read_process_scope: one dataset preparation per independent profile process, exact selected query list; each query retains three warmups and ten owning-output samples
contract_case_unit: one isolated workload family in a private process, at most 30 minutes including setup; failed/inconclusive families retained independently
extended_sampling: at most two independent 100-sample processes when preregistered uncertainty rule applies

resources.durability: default sync and acknowledgements; never disabled

resource_notes: Per-file and Kuzu virtual database mapping caps are stricter than the production 1TiB maximum; the identical 2GiB OS per-file cap applies to every engine.

isolated_family_policy.maintenance: three warmup windows excluded, then ten measured windows with 100 durable batch inserts each; 1000 measured insert observations per process
isolated_family_policy.other_families: full-size semantic and capability observations; one-pass operation timings do not satisfy repeated latency gates; after an unchanged family fails or exhausts 30 minutes, later rounds record the same unmeasurable dependency without repeating the failed workload
isolated_family_policy.prior_dynamic_attempt: 30-minute cutoff, inconclusive; no full-size all-family pass assumed
isolated_family_policy.ordering: maintenance first, then documented family order; three rotating engine orders per family

known_native_budget_limits.aggregate_100000_groups_owning_output: Observed fixed QUERY-budget rejection. Skewed groups and other failures are not exempt.

untimed_fixture_protocol: Committed-prefix continuation is disclosed in each fixture manifest. frozen_control_failure_policy: One failed or timed-out deterministic family/profile is retained; later unchanged independent slots are marked unmeasurable, never success.
prepared_read_protocol: Both native consumers clone identical prepared file; existing frozen-control import failures remain failures and are not repaired/reclassified. progress_logging: One JSON line after each complete window, outside engine-operation timers; identical observational role on both engines.
baseline_version_rule: The original source6a baseline remains separately versioned; no mixed-version overall performance claim.
shared_read_input_policy: Both native consumers clone identical prepared file; existing frozen-control import failures remain failures and are not repaired/reclassified. Input producer source6a and mixed-batch preparation history retained. Formal queries use exact full-result oracles; every failed consumer remains failed.
formal_read_profiles: indexed (medium only; unsupported and failures retained)
new_acceptance: No automatic acceptance: review primary/protection/resource/steady-state gates separately. Failed/inconclusive cases never become passes.
performance_limitations: AS/RSS scope remains as in previous protocol; no claim of 6GiB cgroup equivalence.
Native IPC and Kuzu Python have disclosed unequal entry/trace overheads.
Contract families except maintenance have descriptive operation timings, not invented 3/10 query repeats.
Shared input proves query/read comparability only; it does not measure or repair original import.

premeasurement_space_amendment.output_filesystem: /tmp; 8.8GiB filesystem, 4.5GiB free at registration; both private native clones and all Kuzu working databases are on this same filesystem
premeasurement_space_amendment.original_input: Immutable source remains on /workspace; cloning/preparation is outside query timers. No storage-device-equivalence claim to previous window.

untimed_budget_replay.support_scope: all successful outputs fully checked; declared quota-rejected variants are N/A, never successes or latency ratios
untimed_budget_replay.four_clients: real native threads plus deterministic conflict interleavings; parallel timing deferred

storage_location.scope: Same filesystem and device policy for all engines; cloning and setup excluded from query timers; no cross-window device-I/O equivalence claim.

owned_case_cleanup: Record exact TemporaryDirectory device/inode before use. After the isolated case exits, hash and remove only its still-matching owned clones, including after timeout; retain all raw outcomes. Read-side clones are likewise scoped to the exact owned result directory.

pending_user_decision.rule: No4GiB change without explicit reply. Entire unchanged wide cohort now executes under original2GiB; actual failures/timeouts retained.

timing_persistence_amendment.reason: Old timeout lost operations buffered only in RAM. Persist every25 completed IPC operations after timers return; full final JSON remains authoritative. A killed case only has partial observations, never a completed distribution.

read_resource_scope_correction.reason: Read runner also spawns Git/provenance subprocesses. Aggregate RUSAGE_CHILDREN must not be labeled a single native-engine peak. It may include inherited pre-exec RSS. Numeric values unchanged; no query rerun.
read_resource_scope_correction.contract_scope: Native contract cases launch one worker and no Git helper; their separately recorded child scope remains distinct.

restored_write_protection.scope: Fill the documented immutable-restored-write latency/protection requirement; existing full-family one-pass timings remain descriptive, never relabeled3warm+10. No source, core binary, quota or primary metric change.
restored_write_protection.fixture: 10000 User numeric IDs and4fields, id index; User0 has1MiB unchanged body. Empty Written namespace/id index, oneFOLLOWS edge0->1(weight1). Native nonunique indexes vs Kuzu primary keys disclosed; REMOVE missing-key semantics are KuzuN/A.
restored_write_protection.baseline_rule: After preparation close/reopen RO. Hash immutable database template. Before every warmup and measured sample restore that exact template and validate baseline. Native uses private-path inode swap only while physically readonly, then REOPEN; fixed Linux benchmark orchestration. No new public API/CLI/production code.
restored_write_protection.poststate_rule: After every sampled acknowledgement close/reopen (Native physicallyRO), independently verify full affected values including the entire unchanged1MiB body, IDs/order, exact edge multiplicity or deleted-node/count state. Validation, cloning and opens excluded from the operation timer. Native samples also run the unchanged integrity checker outside their timer.
restored_write_protection.timer_scope: Native existing IPC call including result consumption/check/bookkeeping, versus Kuzu Python execute/drain/check. Entry overhead and schema/durability implementation differences prohibit an unqualified engine-only win claim. Native before/after STATS IO includes the statement only; per-case RSS includes setup/validation and has exactly one native worker/no Git children.
restored_write_protection.limits: unchanged1CPU,6GiBAS/process,2GiBfile,64MiBNativeQuery/Cache and64MiBKuzupool/2GiBmap; default durable synchronized Native publication, normal Kuzu autocommit acknowledgement; no added checkpoint inside query timer.
restored_write_protection.stop_rule: 30min/case including setup; after unchanged failure later rounds unmeasurable. Registered uncertainty limit remains at most2affected100sample processes, not rerun-to-pass.
restored_write_protection.schema_difference: Native User.id and Written.id property indexes are nonunique; Kuzu primary keys include uniqueness/non-null semantics. Report Kuzu numbers descriptively, not as a strict equivalent-schema win. Native control/current schemas and acknowledgement protocols are identical.

restored_write_readwrite_fix: All new rounds use READWRITE after private inode replacement. REOPEN retains the current access mode; no old invalid attempt is mixed in.

wide_fixed_cap_correction.reason: Logical RAW bytes2162688000 are not a lower bound on physical bytes: duplicate LargeValue bodies can share storage. Earlier pending policy inferred an inevitable file-limit failure without measurement. Run the full unchanged workload under the original2GiB cap for every engine and retain actual outcomes.
wide_fixed_cap_correction.four_gib_authorization: Unanswered and unapplied; no affirmative or negative user reply inferred.
wide_fixed_cap_correction.prior_c741_source: Its unattempted wide cohort remains deferred, never retrospectively relabeled.

bounded_extension_scheduling: Apply original range/near-gate uncertainty rule after45base read slots and before writes;2processes×100samples at most per triggered workload/source. No broad profile or Kuzu repeat. Exact triggers registered before supplements; original3×10 kept separate.
